scientific_integrity: Proof is a finite local rook-board classification and an infinite-parameter reduction. Exact independent enumeration checks all 202 local configurations. Historical priority provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exchange-distance-three pairs in standard sparse-paving matroid base-polytope one-skeleta with 3<=rank<=n-3. It does not determine all-distance geodesic distributions or the Euclidean metric.
title: Sharp three-exchange geodesic spectrum of sparse-paving matroid base polytopes
